ability-urge.name: Ability Urge
ability-urge.short_desc: Forcibly activates a friendly Pokemons ability.
ability-urge.desc: Used on a party Pokemon in battle : Selects another friendly Pokemon at random. If that Pokemons ability is normally activated by some conditioni.e., is not continuous and passiveits effect is forcibly activated. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.
ability-urge.flavor_text: When used, it activates the Ability of an ally Pokemon.

dire-hit.name: Dire Hit
dire-hit.short_desc: Increases the chance of a critical hit in battle. Raises happiness.
dire-hit.desc: Used on a party Pokemon in battle : Increases the targets critical hit chance by one stage until it leaves the field. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.
dire-hit.flavor_text: An item that greatly raises the critical-hit ratio of a Pokemon during a battle. It can be used only once and wears off if the Pokemon is withdrawn.

dire-hit-2.name: Dire Hit 2
dire-hit-2.short_desc: Raises critical hit rate by two stages in battle. Wonder Launcher only.
dire-hit-2.desc: Used on a party Pokemon in battle : Raises the targets critical hit rate by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.
dire-hit-2.flavor_text: It can be used many times to raise the critical-hit ratio of one Pokemon. It wears off if the Pokemon is withdrawn.

dire-hit-3.name: Dire Hit 3
dire-hit-3.short_desc: Raises critical hit rate by three stages in battle. Wonder Launcher only.
dire-hit-3.desc: Used on a party Pokemon in battle : Raises the targets critical hit rate by three stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.
dire-hit-3.flavor_text: It can be used many times to greatly raise a Pokemons critical-hit ratio. It wears off if the Pokemon is withdrawn.

guard-spec.name: Guard Spec.
guard-spec.desc: Prevents stat reductions for the player's side during battle.
guard-spec.flavor_text: An item that prevents stat reduction among the Trainers party Pokemon for five turns after it is used in battle.

item-drop.name: Item Drop
item-drop.short_desc: Forces a friendly Pokemon to drop its held item.
item-drop.desc: Used on a party Pokemon in battle : Selects another friendly Pokemon at random. If that Pokemon is holding an item, that item is removed for the duration of the battle. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.
item-drop.flavor_text: When used, it causes an ally Pokemon to drop a held item.

item-urge.name: Item Urge
item-urge.short_desc: Forcibly activates a friendly Pokemons held item.
item-urge.desc: Used on a party Pokemon in battle : Selects another friendly Pokemon at random. If that Pokemon is holding an item normally activated by some conditioni.e., not continuous and passiveits effect is forcibly activated. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.
item-urge.flavor_text: When used, it causes an ally Pokemon to use its held item.

max-mushrooms.name: Max Mushrooms
max-mushrooms.flavor_text: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokemon during battle.

reset-urge.name: Reset Urge
reset-urge.short_desc: Resets a friendly Pokemons stat changes.
reset-urge.desc: Used on a party Pokemon in battle : Selects another friendly Pokemon at random. Removes all of that Pokemons stat changes. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.
reset-urge.flavor_text: When used, it restores any stat changes of an ally Pokemon.
